tools.name: list_photo_specs
tools.description:
List every passport, visa and ID photo spec we publish (including the US online passport renewal and DV lottery): id, country, document,
        size in mm and whether we make the photo (US$8.99 file; the check is free) or only check it.

tools.name: get_photo_spec
tools.description:
Official photo rules for one document: print size, pixels at 300 and 600 dpi, head height, background, glasses, expression,
        digital file limits, what editing the government forbids, and the official source URL with the date we checked it.

tools.name: check_photo_requirements
tools.description:
Check a photo's measurements against a spec: aspect ratio, pixel limits, head height share and file size/format.
        Does not look at the image itself; for a full check use the free checker at page_url.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description:
List every product Passport Sorted sells: prices in US dollars and Kenyan shillings (Paystack charges in KES),
        what you get, and the page URL. Checking a photo is free. Other products are paid one-offs, not subscriptions.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details and price for one product, including how it is delivered and the page to buy it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_photo_spec, list_products · Private data: list_photo_specs, get_photo_spec, check_photo_requirements · Public sink: list_photo_specs, check_photo_requirements · Destructive: check_photo_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_photo_spec, list_products · Private data: list_photo_specs, get_photo_spec, check_photo_requirements · Public sink: list_photo_specs, check_photo_requirements · Destructive: check_photo_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
